notes.title: Honor Cry: Aftermath - Price Reduction and New Game Fixes!
notes.content:
Hello Gamers,
Our RPG experience Honor Cry: Aftermath is getting a new lower price ($1.99 once it takes effect) and a new game patch to improve the game itself!

Changes:
- Increased Item Durability 15-30% so that items don't break so fast.
- Made the first few screens a bit easier in terms of enemies so you don't get ambushed by a vastly superior enemy right as you're starting out.
- Made random encounters about 5% less frequent.
- Streamlined combat so that if there's only 1 enemy, you don't have to click on their name every time.
- Made hit chances a bit higher, about 4%.
- Made the main quest in the second swamp area a bit easier by giving the player a hint where to find the Remove Curse scroll, and giving it to them possibly if they fail in the Gamemaster game 3 or more times.

Comments welcomed. Thanks and enjoy!
Derek
